introduction.message:
Add WorshipTools import to Add show

Add a fourth option to the Add show popup that opens an embedded
WorshipTools Music Stand (persistent session). After signing in and
opening a service, the songs are listed in service order; the chosen
songs are read one at a time (lyrics and section tags only, no chords)
and each is created as its own show.

- Embedded WebContentsView with a read-only preload and a DOM extractor
  for the service menu and rendered charts (multi-page charts supported)
- Directions in the chart are interpreted: x2 and "Repeat Chorus" repeat
  sections, instrumental parts are removed, other directions go to notes
- Same lines per slide / auto groups / format controls as Quick lyrics,
  now shared through LyricsFormatOptions
- Destination: library only, or library and open project (service order)
- Songs that already exist in the library are skipped by default
- Tests: text builder, extractor in a real browser, and a real Electron
  run against a local mock Music Stand page

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

introduction.message:
Phase 2: required code changes for Svelte 5 (legacy mode)

- mount(App, { target }) instead of new App({ target }) in the 6 entry points
  (frontend/main.ts and server/{cam,controller,output_stream,remote,stage}/main.ts)
- add |global to every existing transition:/in:/out: directive (42), including
  the custom transition helper, so transitions keep playing when a parent block
  is added/removed as they did in Svelte 3. The one explicit |local
  (remote Slide.svelte) and two commented out directives are untouched.
- Connection.svelte: a {@const connections} shadowed the $connections store,
  which Svelte 5 rejects. Renamed the local to connectionCount.
- Svelte 5 prunes :has()/descendant selectors it cannot match inside the same
  component (matching elements come from slots / other components). Use
  :global() so the rules are kept: FloatingInputs (.overflow,
  .overflow-interact), Popup (.popup-back), Tabs (.tabs :not(:first-child)).
- EditboxCropping: $activeShow! like the other history() callers (type only)
- vite onwarn: also drop Svelte 5's element_invalid_self_closing_tag build log
  noise (165 files); svelte-check still reports it
- server tsconfig: allowJs so the JS-only VirtualList.svelte resolves under
  strict

  (frontend/main.ts and server/{cam,controller,output_stream,remote,stage}/main.ts)

  the custom transition helper, so transitions keep playing when a parent block
  is added/removed as they did in Svelte 3. The one explicit |local
  (remote Slide.svelte) and two commented out directives are untouched.
- Connection.svelte: a {@const connections} shadowed the $connections store,
  which Svelte 5 rejects. Renamed the local to connectionCount.
- Svelte 5 prunes :has()/descendant selectors it cannot match inside the same
  component (matching elements come from slots / other components). Use
  :global() so the rules are kept: FloatingInputs (.overflow,
  .overflow-interact), Popup (.popup-back), Tabs (.tabs :not(:first-child)).
- EditboxCropping: $activeShow! like the other history() callers (type only)
- vite onwarn: also drop Svelte 5's element_invalid_self_closing_tag build log
  noise (165 files); svelte-check still reports it
- server tsconfig: allowJs so the JS-only VirtualList.svelte resolves under
  strict
